caption: A local UTF-8 file is loaded before creation.
eval:
(async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['tbx-term-import']; for (const m of p.modals) m.close(); p.pro.signOut(); const m = p.openImport("single"); const files = [new File(["<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<martif><text><body>
<termEntry id="c1"><descrip type="definition">A device that moves liquid.</descrip><langSet xml:lang="en"><tig><term>pump</term></tig><tig><term>water pump</term></tig></langSet><langSet xml:lang="fr"><ntig><termGrp><term>pompe</term></termGrp></ntig></langSet><langSet xml:lang="de"><tig><term>Pumpe</term></tig></langSet></termEntry>
<termEntry id="c2"><descrip type="definition">A valve that stops reverse flow.</descrip><langSet xml:lang="en"><tig><term>check valve</term></tig></langSet><langSet xml:lang="fr"><tig><term>clapet anti-retour</term></tig></langSet><langSet xml:lang="de"><tig><term>Rückschlagventil</term></tig></langSet></termEntry>
<termEntry id="c3"><descrip type="definition">Pressure at the inlet.
Check the unit before use.</descrip><langSet xml:lang="en"><tig><term>inlet pressure</term></tig></langSet><langSet xml:lang="de"><tig><term>Einlassdruck</term></tig></langSet></termEntry>
<termEntry><langSet xml:lang="en"><tig><term>record without an ID</term></tig></langSet></termEntry>
</body></text></martif>
"], "Pump terms.tbx", { type: "application/xml" })]; const dt = new DataTransfer(); files.forEach((f) => dt.items.add(f)); m.contentEl.querySelector("[data-tbx=file]").files = dt.files; await m.loadFiles(files);  return 'ready'; })()
